title: Exact Hessian Cancellation and Quartic Nondegeneracy at the Round Circle
summary: We study the decomposed Möbius energies $E_1$ and $E_2$ at the round circle and determine their complete normal Hessians: $H_1(C)=2π(|D_s|^3-|D_s|)I_2$ and $H_2(C)=-(4π/3)(|D_s|^3-|D_s|)I_2$. Thus $H_1(C)=3H_E(C)$ and $H_2(C)=-2H_E(C)$, where $H_E(C)$ is the Hessian of the full Möbius energy. This exact proportionality singles out the Möbius-invariant combination $F=2E_1+3E_2+2π^2$. We prove that $F(C)=0$ and that its first three derivatives vanish on the full space of parametrized variations.
